tasks.short: Select suitable work and life-skills activities

steps.what: Select activities within the individual's mental and physical capabilities

tasks.design: Retain individual activity selection and adaptation with the therapist. Existing {DOCS} activity references may support the choice, but no clinically validated selection engine is established in this digest.
tasks.previous_blocker: Capabilities and activity demands interact with the person's goals and environment.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing references support professional selection without establishing a labour saving.
tasks.still_hard: Judging tolerable challenge and adapting to fluctuating capacity.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the person, negotiate goals and adjust activities safely.
tasks.altitude: Clinical selection rights and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish shared goals from discipline-specific assessment

evidence.claim: Individual therapeutic activity selection remains professional judgement; no relevant validated automation is supplied in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary covers selection, excluding prior comprehensive assessment and subsequent therapy delivery.
Therapist uses existing assessments and direct observations; no structured capability score or machine decision is assumed.
Check native reference access before adding tools. Unchanged selection introduces zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which features of activity selection require direct observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Access to activity references does not itself shorten individual clinical selection.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate patient progress against functional goals and document supporting observations
Prepare progress report wording from the therapist's evaluated account

loop.input: Therapist's evaluated account and report template
loop.output: Draft progress report with uncertainties and source links
loop.check: Therapist checks functional change, assistance levels, dates, goals, adverse observations and limitations against the source account
loop.stop: One draft; missing evidence or disputed change returns to manual reporting
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative functional progress requires contextual wording beyond copying scores

steps.what: Confirm clinical meaning and release the final progress report

tasks.design: The {OTHER} clinical record system supplies the therapist's evaluated progress account to a bounded {DOCS} report draft. The therapist checks factual and clinical meaning and releases the exact final report; assessment and patient contact retain their full time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical findings need repeated translation into a consistent report narrative.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinician-validated consultation-note drafting exists; progress-report transfer remains an unmeasured local design.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding exaggerated improvement or omitted support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret functional change in the patient's actual daily life.
tasks.altitude: Less initial wording, with unchanged assessment and report accountability.

reach.learn: Link functional claims to dated observations

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation notes for clinician validation; this supports a documentation pattern, not occupational therapy progress evaluation.
The proposed progress-report wording aid and 40% reduction in its composition component are unmeasured assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary covers this progress evaluation and report, excluding therapy delivery; source capture is not claimed again in another task.

Therapist produces dated observations, goals, assistance levels, interpreted change and uncertainties in s1. Its full 55 hours include assessment and source capture; drafting does not invent missing findings or independently interpret scores.
Try native report templates and dictation first. Missing source evidence returns to manual reporting.
Four additional focal hours cover source audits, template changes and failed drafts.
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total report effort after source and clinical checks?

incremental.description: Source audits, template maintenance and exceptional failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact report version, patient identity, dated observations, progress interpretation and recipients; any edit requires renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+18+15=88, gross=12, upkeep=4, net=8. High assumes 40% less initial wording time for well-recorded progress; low retains manual wording for complex or ambiguous change plus upkeep. Evaluation and patient contact never shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Train caregivers to meet patient needs during and after therapy

tasks.design: Keep demonstration, caregiver practice and understanding checks with the therapist. Existing {DOCS} instructions remain supporting material; they do not replace observation of safe care techniques.
tasks.previous_blocker: Caregivers need practical demonstration and feedback tailored to the patient.
tasks.enabler_now: No new validated capability in the digest establishes shorter caregiver training.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe technique and realistic limits on caregiver capacity.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt teaching, build confidence and check actual performance.
tasks.altitude: Direct caregiver teaching time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Agree consistent instructions and escalation signals

evidence.claim: Instruction materials do not demonstrate caregiver competence; direct training remains intact in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is therapist teaching, excluding caregiver practice outside the session and routine care delivery.
Therapist observes understanding and technique during the counted training step; no machine-ready competence field or automated certification is assumed.
Use existing instruction templates first. No new workflow means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Can caregivers safely demonstrate the taught technique in the actual setting?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Demonstration, feedback and understanding checks retain all therapist time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate therapy with the rehabilitation team

steps.what: Consult the rehabilitation team to select and coordinate therapeutic activities

tasks.design: Retain multidisciplinary consultation and resolution of conflicting activity plans. Existing {DOCS} assessments support the meeting, without assuming a separate administrative baseline or automatic clinical allocation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different disciplines must reconcile priorities and treatment interactions.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access can support consultation but does not establish a shorter decision conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving incompatible goals and changing functional limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Explain occupational goals and negotiate a coherent rehabilitation approach.
tasks.altitude: Clinical coordination rights and meeting time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Recognise treatment interactions and shared functional goals

evidence.claim: Multidisciplinary clinical consultation is not replaced by document access in this proposed workflow.

assumptions: Boundary is occupational therapist consultation time; colleague time is excluded from the denominator and unchanged. Individual activity selection in task 350 is distinct from joint reconciliation; allocate shared decisions once in roll-ups.
Team members produce their discipline assessments under existing care processes; no structured automated selection input is assumed.
Check native record sharing first. Retained consultation creates no new upkeep.
research_questions: Which conflicting goals require direct multidisciplinary resolution?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Consultation and joint clinical reconciliation retain all time; no colleague time enters the focal saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Some report wording may take less time; direct assessment, activity selection, caregiver teaching and team decisions remain professional work.
reach: Align rehabilitation goals with physical therapists
Audit report source traceability with medical records specialists
role.ambitious_version: An occupational therapist who produces clearer traceable reports while protecting personal assessment and practical teaching time.
